heroSummary: Omaha Public Schools begins 2026–27 with a staggered start: kindergarten and entry-level grades at middle and high schools attend August 19, all other K–12 students begin August 20, and Pre-K begins August 26. Thanksgiving Recess runs November 23–27, Winter Recess December 21–January 4, and Spring Recess March 15–19. Seniors finish May 14, and the main district calendar's last student day is May 26. Wilson Focus Elementary follows a separate calendar.

calendarNotes: OPS uses three opening dates: August 19 for kindergarten and entry-level grades at middle and high schools, August 20 for all other K–12 students, and August 26 for Pre-K. All students have two-hour late starts on September 29, October 27, January 26, and February 23. Several dates apply only to certain students: selected Alternative Education programs are closed September 4 and 11; grades 11–12 do not attend on the November 10 PreACT day; Early Childhood and kindergarten do not attend January 15; and grades 9, 10, and 12 do not attend on the April 6 ACT day. Early Childhood has additional no-school days. Wilson Focus begins August 4, ends June 16, and follows its own enrichment and recess schedule. Wilson-only dates are not included in the main event table or ICS file.

calendarFaqs.q: Is August 19 the first day for every OPS student?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Kindergarten and entry-level grades at middle and high schools begin August 19, 2026. All other K–12 students begin August 20, and Pre-K begins August 26. Wilson Focus Elementary starts August 4 under its separate calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: When are the OPS two-hour late starts in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: The district calendar lists two-hour late starts for all students on September 29, October 27, January 26, and February 23. Wilson Focus and Alternative Programs use school-specific hours, so families should confirm program and transportation details.

calendarFaqs.q: When are Omaha Public Schools conferences in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: OPS conference weeks are October 19–23, 2026, and March 8–12, 2027. All students have no school October 22–23 and March 11–12. Individual schools provide conference appointment times.

calendarFaqs.q: Does my child have school on November 10 or April 6?
calendarFaqs.a: It depends on the student's grade. Grades 9 and 10 take the PreACT on November 10 while grades 11 and 12 do not attend. Grade 11 takes the ACT on April 6 while grades 9, 10, and 12 do not attend.

calendarFaqs.q: Does OPS Early Childhood have extra no-school days?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. The Early Childhood calendar adds no-school days throughout the year, including September 25, October 16, November 20, December 18, February 11, March 26, April 15, and May 14. Early Childhood and kindergarten are also out January 15.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Wilson Focus Elementary follow the main OPS calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Wilson Focus begins August 4, 2026, ends June 16, 2027, and publishes four enrichment sessions plus Wilson-only no-school periods. Families at Wilson should use the separate official PDF linked in Downloads.

The Early Childhood calendar adds program-specific no-school days, while the Wilson Focus calendar covers its separate August 4–June 16 schedule. sourceReviewDetails: Each school year, MySchoolDates checks the dates shown on this page against the district's published calendar and other official calendar documents.

If we find a mismatch, we correct the page and update its review date. This page covers major districtwide student dates along with selected grade- and program-specific exceptions published in the official calendars. School-specific dismissal times, staff details, and program events may appear only in the official PDF or individual school calendars. The downloadable calendar file is a one-time import generated from the calendar records used for this page, and the official district calendar remains the source of record for last-minute changes.
Confirm program deadlines, transportation notices, and emergency schedule changes directly with OPS.
